$comment: Third-party code and assets in DiaDraw that do not come from npm: the one hand-kept list of them. tools/gen/credits.mjs adds the npm packages from the lockfiles and writes docs/credits.md (the website's Credits page) and src/host/data/credits.tsv (the About dialogs of every app). Run `node tools/gen/credits.mjs` after changing this file or a dependency. `apps` names where a component ships: cli, gtk, macos, winui, web, desktop, vscode, confluence, confluence-drawio, markdown, node, python, rust, site, or repo (in the repository only, for building or testing); `core` is every build of the C++ core, `native` its native builds and `wasm` its WebAssembly build.

components.name: miniz
components.copyright: Rich Geldreich, RAD Game Tools, Valve Software
components.use: Deflate and inflate: compressed draw.io pages, PNG text chunks, gzip and packed libraries

components.name: lunasvg
components.use: PNG export in native builds

components.name: plutovg
components.use: The 2D rasteriser under lunasvg

components.name: C4-PlantUML
components.use: Macro signatures for the PlantUML importer (vendored in third_party/C4-PlantUML)

components.name: Adobe Helvetica font metrics
components.use: Character widths of Helvetica for PDF export (no font is embedded)

components.name: Unicode Character Database
components.use: Letter, number, case and NFKD tables compiled into the core

components.name: draw.io stencil sets
components.use: The drawio-* shape libraries, converted to SVG (assets/drawio, see assets/NOTICE)
components.notes: draw.io adds a restriction to its stencils: they and their derivatives may not be used in Atlassian products or products distributed through the Atlassian Marketplace without JGraph's written permission. The icon sets of vendors (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cisco and others) stay subject to their owners' trademark and icon terms.

components.name: draw.io
components.use: The diagram editor that the Confluence draw.io app bundles (with draw.io's LICENSE)
components.notes: The bundled web app includes draw.io's stencils, which carry the Atlassian restriction described under draw.io stencil sets.

components.name: Emscripten runtime
components.use: The WebAssembly module's JavaScript glue and C library (with musl, MIT, and LLVM libc++, Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception)

components.name: gtkmm
components.use: The Linux app's C++ interface to GTK, with glibmm, cairomm and pangomm (LGPL-2.1-or-later), dynamically linked

components.name: libsigc++
components.use: Signals and slots for gtkmm, dynamically linked

components.name: GTK
components.use: The Linux app's toolkit, with GLib, Pango and Cairo, dynamically linked

components.name: libcurl
components.use: HTTPS for Google Drive and OneDrive in the macOS and Linux apps

components.name: Windows App SDK (WinUI 3)
components.license: MIT (source); runtime under Microsoft Software License Terms
components.use: The Windows app's user interface

components.name: C++/WinRT
components.use: The Windows app's C++ projection of the Windows Runtime

components.name: Win2D
components.use: The Windows app's canvas drawing

components.name: WebView2 SDK
components.use: Referenced by WinUI

components.name: Tauri
components.copyright: The Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy
components.use: The desktop app's shell, with tauri-plugin-dialog and tauri-plugin-fs
components.notes: Its Rust crates (and theirs) are listed here once the desktop app has a Cargo.lock.

components.name: serde, serde_json
components.use: JSON in the desktop app's Rust side

components.name: nanobind
components.use: The Python package's bindings (with robin-map, MIT)

components.name: node-addon-api
components.use: The Node.js addon's C++ bindings (header-only)

components.name: googletest
components.use: C++ tests

npmLicenses.$comment: Licences for npm packages whose package.json does not name an SPDX licence, by package name or scope prefix.
